evidence_record: d0:p0 attributes JumbledPath use to Salt Typhoon.
d1:p1 describes remote packet capture; d2:p2 explicitly restates the same MITRE account.
d2:p3 adds compression and encryption of captured packet data, attributed to the same MITRE source.

claims.text: Salt Typhoon’s reported use of JumbledPath supports an assessment that it has a tool capable of capturing network packets from remote devices.
claims.reporting_relationship: The actor attribution and capability description reference the same MITRE entry. d2:p2 is an explicit restatement, not independent corroboration.

claims.text: The JumbledPath capability attributed to Salt Typhoon also includes compression and encryption of captured packet data. The cards do not establish that the actor exercised these functions in a particular operation.
claims.reporting_relationship: d2:p3 preserves an additional capability fact within the composed card, but attributes it to the same MITRE source; it adds no reporting origin.

limitations: These researcher-authored paraphrases reference one reporting origin and are not complete published reports. They support tool-level capability inferences, not verification of particular operations, targets, scale, effectiveness, or frequency. Missing details do not establish that an event never occurred.
